findings.title: Dark mode: the article newsletter rail is white text on light navy (1.8–2.2:1) across 44 routes
findings.evidence: axe color-contrast, dark theme: `.dp-aside-newsletter > .dp-rail-heading` #ffffff on #8fb3cc = 2.21:1; `> p` 2.03:1; `> .eyebrow` 1.84:1 — 44 routes, 132 nodes. The same token drives `.cta` on /airlines/ (51 nodes, 2.21:1) and `.eyebrow` on 7 routes.
findings.impact: WCAG 2.2 AA 1.4.3 failure on every long-form page for dark-mode readers; the block is the newsletter conversion path.
findings.minimumFix: In the dark override block give the rail its own surface: `[data-theme="dark"] .dp-aside-newsletter { background: #1f3a4d; }` (brand navy, inside the permitted family) and keep text white; audit the other `background: var(--green)` call sites (`grep -n 'background: var(--green)' src/styles/global.css`).

findings.title: Light mode: small gold and muted labels fall below 4.5:1 on 83 routes (346 nodes)
findings.evidence: `.eyebrow` #b8842a on #f8f5ee at 11px = 3.02:1 (44 card reviews); `.dp-bank-callout > .label` #b8842a on #f3ead6 = 2.75:1 (15 hubs); `.dp-expiry-block > .label` 3.21:1 at 10px (6 programme pages); AEDValueBreakdown `.dpvb-axis span`, `.dpvb-eyebrow`, `.dpvb-bluf-label`, `.dpvb-bar-gross`, `.unit`, `.kind` #72818b on #faf6ef = 3.72:1 (11 cashback reviews, 5 selectors each); `.dp-bank-card-cta` #83919a on #fdfcf8 = 3.15:1 (15 hubs).
findings.impact: Eyebrows and value-bar axes are the scanning layer the five-second test depends on; at 10–11px they are the first thing a low-vision reader loses.
findings.minimumFix: Introduce a text-weight gold token (`--gold-ink: #8a6118`, ≥ 4.6:1 on paper) for labels ≤ 14px and keep `--gold` for chips, rules and the Verified badge; raise the muted-text token used by AEDValueBreakdown and `.dp-bank-card-cta` to `--ink-soft` (#5f6d77-class). Two-token change, no layout change.
knockOn: Charter two-accent rule (gold keeps one job: trust signal; the ink variant is a shade, not a new hue)
tests: none exist — add an axe contrast assertion to tests/audit/

findings.title: Mobile hamburger is focusable but not keyboard-operable on all 199 routes
findings.anchor: src/components/Header.astro:131 (label[for=dp-nav-toggle] role=button tabindex=0) · probes-summary.json menu {enterOpens:false, spaceOpens:false, escapeCloses:false} ×199
findings.evidence: The CSS-only menu is a <label> for a hidden checkbox; Enter and Space do nothing (labels do not activate on keydown), Escape does not close. The Firecrawl form census also exposes the three accordion checkboxes as unlabeled controls ('Cards ▾', 'Points + Miles ▾', 'Travel ▾').
findings.impact: Keyboard and switch users cannot open site navigation on a phone-width viewport.
findings.minimumFix: Add an 8-line inline script: on keydown Enter/Space on `label[for="dp-nav-toggle"]` → preventDefault, toggle the checkbox, mirror `aria-expanded`; on Escape → uncheck and refocus the label. Give the accordion inputs `aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"` like the nav toggle.

findings.title: Tracker rows carry aria-expanded on role=row inside a table (axe aria-conditional-attr, serious) on 6 routes
findings.evidence: `.dpst-row` sets aria-expanded; the attribute is valid on treegrid rows, not table rows, so screen readers ignore or mis-announce the expandable state.
findings.minimumFix: Move `aria-expanded={isOpen}` (and `aria-controls`) onto the toggle <button> inside the row; leave the <tr> without it.

findings.title: Homepage h1 is announced as 'Fly further. Payless.'

findings.title: "Join brief" header CTA is a mystery label and wraps to two lines at 1280 px

findings.title: Hero image has `sizes` but no `srcset`: 1880px / 380 KB JPEG served to a 342px slot, and it is the LCP element
findings.evidence: index.astro:368-377: bare `` with no `srcset` (sizes is inert without one). data/stock/manifest.json: guide-dubai-shopping-festival-2026.jpg 1880×1253, 380,180 bytes on disk. Probe metrics: lcpElement `header.dp-pagehead.hp-hero > … > img`, aboveFoldBytes 970,625, transferredBytes 1,606,886, requests 25. StockImage.astro (lines 74, 95) also forwards `sizes` without `srcset`, so this is a site pattern; the hero is where it costs most. Joint call with Technical Lead per role; fast trumps pretty.
findings.impact: Roughly 250–300 KB of avoidable download on the LCP image for the 70% mobile audience on transit connections.
findings.minimumFix: Generate a ~940w derivative of the hero file and add `srcset="/images/stock/…-940.jpg 940w, /images/stock/….jpg 1880w"` to the hero (index.astro:368-377).
knockOn: If generalised, StockImage.astro and scripts/images fetch pipeline need a resize step (T3)
manifest schema if derivative paths are recorded
alternatives: Migrate the hero to astro:assets <Image> with widths=[480,940,1880]

findings.title: Boxed tool tiles collapse to ~85px text columns at 360px
findings.evidence: crops/m0.png: tool descriptions wrap to 4–5 lines ('Rank 57 / cards / against your / spending', 'See which / welcome / offer pays / back first') and titles to 3 lines ('Welcome- / bonus / calculator'). Cause: 2-up grid inside a 312px strip, `.dp-tool-strip.is-boxed .dp-tool { padding: 26px 24px 22px }` (global.css:1188-1193) plus `.go { padding-right: 22px }` to clear the corner arrow (1216-1219) leaves ~85px for 13px text. index.astro is the only consumer of `.is-boxed`.

findings.minimumFix: Add `@media (max-width: 480px) { .dp-tool-strip.is-boxed { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .dp-tool-strip.is-boxed .dp-tool:nth-child(even) { border-left: 0; } .dp-tool-strip.is-boxed .dp-tool + .dp-tool { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } }` in global.css after line 1203.
knockOn: Seam comment at global.css:1195-1198 should be updated to describe the 1-col case
alternatives: Keep 2-up but cut padding to 18px/16px and hide `.arrow` below 480px

findings.title: Firecrawl tool applicability for this publication (method note)
